task_goal: Construct a deep learning model to predict the ribosome loading (translation efficiency) of human 5′ UTR sequences measured by polysome profiling MPRA experiments.
task_requirements: The model should take 5′ UTR sequences as input and predict translation efficiency (RL) as a regression task.

task_dataset.description: Dataset from MPRA polysome profiling experiments containing randomized or designed human 5′ UTR sequences and their ribosome loading measurements across multiple fractions.
task_dataset.key_constraints: Input sequences are 5′ UTRs with lengths 59 nucleotides. Test set has been reserved for evaluation, so you only need to split the data into train/val set.
